title: Work in Sage Intacct from Claude, with the superglue MCP
summary: Sage Intacct users can now create and update records straight from Claude.
body_markdown:
Sage Intacct users can now create and update records straight from Claude.


Set up general ledger accounts, post journal entries, add vendors and customers. You do it all in one conversation.


Sage's own MCP server is read-only. It answers questions about your data and helps you decide what to change.
The superglue MCP goes one step further and incorporates reads and writes.


## Who it is for


Sage Intacct users and implementation consultants. Consultants build the chart of accounts, load the master data and clean up after the migration. Operational teams make their day-to-day changes without learning Intacct.


## What it is worth


It saves time. Your AI assistant makes the actual change instead of giving instruction on how the change would be executed manually.


Implementations especially are full of small corrections, like a missing account or a wrong department. Each one means opening Intacct, finding the right screen and typing it in.


With the superglue MCP the data review and the fix happen in the same thread. Ask which accounts from the mapping file are missing, then tell it to create them. The superglue agent asks for your approval before anything changes in Sage. Clicking through screens becomes a few messages.


## superglue already does this work at scale


A Sage partner running 40 Intacct implementations cut migration hours per project by 80% with superglue. One QuickBooks to Intacct migration had taken them 140 consultant hours before.


## Try it


Try it and move things around in your own Sage Intacct sandbox or a test company.


[https://superglue.ai/mcp/sage-intacct/](https://superglue.ai/mcp/sage-intacct/)


Install the MCP directly in superglue or connect it to Claude, ChatGPT, Langdock, Microsoft Copilot or Google Gemini.
